english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for putting an object somewhere out of sight.
This is the everyday all-purpose choice for putting a physical thing out of sight.
Use 收埋 when goods are being put away or kept somewhere safely, often out of sight.

examples.english: I hide the snacks in the drawer.
examples.traditional: 我將啲零食收埋喺櫃桶入面。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 ling4 sik6 sau1 maai4 hai2 gwai6 tung2 jap6 min6

examples.english: I conceal the documents in the drawer.
examples.traditional: 我將啲文件收埋喺櫃桶入面。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 man4 gin6 sau1 maai4 hai2 gwai6 tung2 jap6 min6

examples.english: We need to deposit the cash somewhere safe so no one sees it.
examples.traditional: 啲現金要收埋，唔好畀人見到。
examples.jyutping: di1 jin6 gam1 jiu3 sau1 maai4 m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 gin3 dou2

english.note: Use this colloquial choice when something is deliberately kept out of sight, including keeping feelings or thoughts to oneself.
Use this for the figurative sense of bottling up feelings or emotions rather than for literal liquids.
Choose 收埋 when the emphasis is on hiding something away, especially feelings, secrets, or something being concealed from view.

examples.english: I don't want to dissemble by hiding my feelings.
examples.traditional: 我唔想收埋自己嘅感受。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 sau1 maai4 zi6 gei2 ge3 gam2 sau6

examples.english: They always bottle up their feelings and refuse to talk to anyone.
examples.traditional: 佢成日收埋自己嘅情緒，唔肯同人講。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sau1 maai4 zi6 gei2 ge3 cing4 seoi5 m4 hang2 tung4 jan4 gong2

examples.english: I had to bury this sadness deep in my heart.
examples.traditional: 我將呢段傷心事收埋喺心底。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 ni1 dyun6 soeng1 sam1 si6 sau1 maai4 hai2 sam1 dai2
